# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **HarfBuzz update and script coverage**

## Highlights

The next release updates HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 named script constants. The update keeps the existing Script struct API and HarfBuzzSharp assembly version while moving its packages to version 15.0.0.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 15.0.0 and moves HarfBuzzSharp packages from 14.4.0.300 to 15.0.0. The HarfBuzzSharp assembly version remains 1.0.0.0. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **Complete named script coverage** — Adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, bringing the named constants to 179. Existing field values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain unchanged. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))
